function.name: SAVE_FPG
function.param: Code of the library to save
function.abstract: It saves in disk a FPG library

description.p: This function creates or overwrites an archive in disk in FPG format, with the content of a FPG library on memory that can have been creatid with the function , or recovered of disk by . The changes made on memory with function like or do not affect to the original archive in disk, so that it is necessary to use this function to overwrite if you want.

function.note: The archives created with SAVE_FPG can not be recovered from DIV Games Studio.
